title: The owner cannot see whether an alert or the daily summary reached any phone, or why not
what: With the admin app closed, alerts and the 11:00 summary are sent by the server. The server notes for each alert whether it went at once, went in the summary, went to nobody because no device had alerts on, or was too old to send, but the admin app never shows this. Only the test alert has a record the owner can open. An owner who believes the summary came every day has no place to check that it did, or why it did not.
expected: Each alert in the bell (or a short history in Settings, Alerts) says when it was sent and to how many devices, or why it was not sent.
who: owners and desk staff who use closed-app alerts
fix_line: Show each alert's sent time and device count, or the reason it was not sent, next to it in the bell.

title: A renew request stays waiting after the desk renews the member another way, and Approve then sells a second plan as a due
what: A member asks in the app to renew. If the desk renews them from the member page (the usual sell sheet), the request does not learn of it: it stays in Needs you, the bell and the Today card. Approve later checks only for a sale made by that same request, so it sells the plan again, starting after the plan just sold, with the full price left as a due and no question asked.
expected: A request whose member already got a new plan after the request was made leaves the lists, or Approve warns that the member was renewed already.
who: members who ask to renew in the app, and the desk
how_often: each time a member asks in the app and is then renewed at the desk
fix_line: Before Approve sells, check for any plan sold to the member after the request and ask, or close the request.

title: A join request stays under Joined online after the desk adds the same person through Add member
what: Someone fills the gym join page, then walks in, and the desk adds them with Add member. The request is marked joined only when the desk taps Make member on the Joined online card, so the card and the bell keep showing a person waiting to join who is already a member.
expected: A join request whose number is already a member leaves Joined online and the bell, or the card says they are already a member.
how_often: each time an online joiner is added at the desk by hand
fix_line: Match waiting join requests to members by mobile number and close or flag them.

title: A member already sent the plan ending message from the one by one list is still offered it on Renewals due
what: The one by one WhatsApp list remembers who was sent the plan ending message, but only inside that list on that browser. The Renewals due list on Today and the member page never read it, so they offer the same message to the same member with no sign it went, and another staff member starts the list from the top. Members can get the same reminder twice.
expected: Every place that offers the reminder shows that it was sent, when and by whom.
how_often: each plan ending reminder sent from the list
fix_line: Keep a sent-on date per member and message on the server and show it on Renewals due and the member page.
